key.name: opacity-level
key.description: Opacity level for windows (0-100%, where 0% is fully transparent and 100% is fully opaque)

key.name: debug-mode
key.description: Enable debug logging to console for troubleshooting

key.name: opacity-step
key.description: Amount the window opacity changes per scroll tick, on the 0-255 actor opacity scale

key.name: min-opacity
key.description: Lowest opacity (0-255) reachable via Alt+scroll, to prevent windows becoming invisible

key.name: modifier-key
key.description: Modifier held while scrolling to change window opacity: 'alt', 'super', 'ctrl', 'shift', or 'altgr'
